turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Meridian Home Loans, Jordan speaking. Name and property address please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mei Lam. It's 27 Ardwick Street, Sunshine West.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Got it. I can see there's an arrears balance on the account. Are you calling about that?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. I've missed the last two and I don't think I'm going to make the next one either.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Okay. What's the plan to bring the account back up to date?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's the thing, I don't really have one. I had surgery in July and I'm signed off work until at least February. I'm on the income protection but it's about sixty per cent of what I was on.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Right. And is there anyone else contributing to the household?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, it's just me. Look, I've done the numbers a dozen times. On sixty per cent I cannot cover the repayment. Not next month, not the month after. It's going to be like this until I'm cleared to go back, and that's four or five months away at best.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. Mei, what you've just described counts as a hardship notice — that's a formal thing under the National Credit Code, and it means we have to look at changing your arrangements. I'm lodging it now while we're on the call.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh. I didn't know that was something you could do.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Most people don't. We've got twenty-one days from today to assess it and come back to you with a decision, and I'd expect it well before that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And the letters? I got one last week that mentioned legal action. Does that stop?

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Yes. While a hardship application is open the collections activity pauses. I'm putting a hold on the account now so nothing automated goes out to you.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: There are a few things we can look at — pausing repayments for a period, or moving you to interest-only while you're off work. I'll need some information about income and expenses to work out which fits.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can get that together. How do I send it?

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: I'll email a form today. And Mei — if you'd rather not do this on your own, free financial counselling is available and they can deal with us on your behalf. No cost to you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I might take that. Thank you.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: That's what the call is for. I'll get that email out within the hour.
